subject: Animation streaming and IFP file format (CAnimManager, ANP3)

sections.description: root container; 4-byte child count follows magic
animation block info: total anim count (uint32)
block name string, null-padded to 24 bytes
per-animation wrapper: NAME child + CPAN child array
compressed bone channel; contains ANIM child
bone animation header: bone name (24B), num_frames (uint16), keyframe_type (uint16), flags (uint32)

keyframe_types.4: rotation only (16B per frame: quaternion xyzw)

anim_group_ids.note: Animation groups (AnimAssocDefinition entries) are enumerated in animgrp.dat. Each line defines the group name, IFP file, and animation names within that IFP.

streaming_slots.description: IFP files are streamed on demand via the standard CStreaming slot system. CStreamingInfo has one slot per registered IFP. IFPs are reference-counted; CAnimManager::RemoveAnimBlock decrements the ref and marks the slot free.

CAnimBlendStaticAssociation.description: Non-looping, non-blended association. Used for scripted one-shot anims.

CAnimBlendAssociation.description: Blendable animation association with weight/speed. Most in-game movement uses this.

CAnimBlendClumpData.description: Per-clump (model) animation state; holds the linked list of active associations.

CAnimBlendSequence.description: Stores the bone keyframe data for one CPAN block from the IFP.
